top_concerns: Core claim of test-time budget/price control from one checkpoint is never shown: no budget/price sweeps or Pareto curves

Constraint-satisfaction experiment is weak (feasibility 0.34, infeasible budgets, dual value as a quality metric); latency is above Vanilla RAG in most settings despite the abstract's latency-reduction claim
Baseline fairness and setup unclear: RL-trained CLAUSE vs. mostly zero-shot baselines, KG construction for HotpotQA, no specialised KGQA/LLM+KG baselines, no seeds or variance
Missing training and implementation details; appendix with algorithms, convergence and shadow-price proof is unresolved ('Appendix ??')
Algorithmic novelty is a combination of MAPPO, QMIX mixer, COMA and Lagrangian duals; ablations do not isolate these components or the provenance claims
